question: operator 2026-10-09: push cIoU beyond the record via a stronger trained selector over the existing candidate pool (light supervision)

attempts.name: A: GBM part-scorer, absolute threshold tau
attempts.protocol: parts = the shipped pool picks + the uncapped SAM masks; 12 features; HistGradientBoostingRegressor on 70% of the held-out TRAIN refs; tau chosen on the remaining 30%; applied once to val
attempts.verdict: FAILS to transfer: -12.20 cIoU against the shipped 50.99 on val

attempts.name: B: per-frame feature standardization + relative threshold alpha
attempts.protocol: same parts/model, features z-scored per frame (label-free), keep parts >= alpha * max within the record; alpha on the held-out 30%

measured_cause.prediction_shift: predicted part-IoU mean 0.413 (train carve-out) vs 0.355 (1,500-record val sample); fraction of parts with predicted IoU >= 0.65: 11.4% (train) vs 4.6% (that val sample); the full-val pass (14,229 records) kept 4,829/89,705 parts = 5.4% - the three denominators are stated so the sample statistic and the full-pass count are not conflated
measured_cause.interpretation: the available train-side record set (the 1,784-sentence train-tune carve-out) is not distributionally comparable to val (different term composition and detector-box quality). The GBM generalises within the train carve-out (the 30% held-out refs gain +6.8) but does not transfer across the train->val gap; the shipped hand rule is precisely the structure that absorbed that gap. Attack B's partial recovery (38.79 -> 41.63 under a shift-mitigating rule) shows covariate shift explains part of the failure, not all: the residual -9.4 cIoU indicates the supervision volume (780 refs) is also insufficient.

conclusion: the light-supervision route over this pool cannot clear the record with the available train-side data; closing the gap needs train-side scoring passes at scale (the full gRefCOCO train split), outside the shared-GPU budget. The record was instead pushed by a train-side hand-knob re-selection (change 16): cIoU 50.9864 -> 51.3182, gIoU 74.7171 -> 74.9098 (gref_topk_reselection.json).
